A1.prompt_constraints: Write Modern Standard Arabic (فصحى), fully unvowelled. Use ONLY the present/imperfect indicative of Form I verbs, and equational (nominal) sentences. Short simple sentences. Do NOT use the past (الماضي), future سـ/سوف, dual, إنّ/أنّ, relative الذي/التي, كان + verb, لم/لن, the subjunctive after أنْ, the passive, or derived verb Forms II–X. No subordinate clauses with لأن، إذا، عندما. Attached pronouns on verbs are OK only as independent words (هو، هي، أنا). Mark hamza where it belongs (إلى، إن). Do not mix in English or dialect (عامية).

A2.prompt_constraints: Modern Standard Arabic, unvowelled. Present, past (الماضي Form I), and future with سـ or سوف are OK. Form II and Form IV verbs that are common at this level are OK. Simple لأن / إذا / عندما OK. Do NOT use dual, إنّ/أنّ, relative الذي, كان + verb, لم/لن, subjunctive أنْ, the passive, or Forms III, V–X. Keep sentences short. No dialect.

B1.prompt_constraints: إنّ/أنّ, الذي/التي, كان + imperfect, dual, لم + jussive, أنْ + subjunctive, and Forms II, IV, V, VII, VIII, X are welcome. Imperative OK. Do NOT use the passive voice or rare Forms VI and IX. Calibrate vocabulary to B1. No dialect, no English.

B2.prompt_constraints: Passive, extra derived forms, حال, and fuller hypotaxis are allowed. Calibrate vocabulary to B2 MSA. Do not use colloquial dialect or rare C1+ literary syntax (مقامات, heavy Sajʿ).
